_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::fpsi#6, and a FALSIFICATION of both the key it names and the default it assumes. The entry said 'omitting BJS defaults to no-slip' and told the reader to 'set the SLIP_COEFF in DESIGN FPSI COUPLING SURF CONDITIONS'. That condition accepts only E / ENTITY_TYPE / NODE_SET_NAME / coupling_id, so SLIP_COEFF is rejected at parse time with 'Could not match this input' from core/fem/src/condition/4C_fem_condition_definition.cpp line 79. The real key is FPSI DYNAMIC/ALPHABJ, described in fpsi/4C_fpsi_input.cpp as the Beavers-Joseph-Coefficient for the slip boundary condition at the fluid-porous interface with documented range 0.1-4, and its default is 1.0, not no-slip: on upstream fpsi_ofsiinterface.4C.yaml writing ALPHABJ: 1.0 explicitly reproduces the untouched deck exactly (both arms 0 failed tests), while ALPHABJ: 4.0 moves the answer enough to fail both 1e-10 result tests. Verified by execution 2026-08-06 against 4C at /home/alexander/4C/build/4C (2026.2.0-dev, commit 89519cfe76).
expect_in_output: Result check failed with 2 errors out of 2 tests

_mutation.note: remove the fabricated-key pathology: stop injecting SLIP_COEFF. SLIPCOEFF_IN_DECK drops to 0 (a forbidden token) and the parse abort vanishes, so the fixture must go red.
remove the coefficient contrast: set the big arm to the default 1.0. BIG_ARM_[ALPHABJ:1.0] is a forbidden token, ALPHABJ4_FAILED_TESTS drops to 0 and the fixture must go red.
